Common questions,
clear answers.

Which training program should I choose?+

Start with your current skills and career goal. Contact our team to discuss program content, prerequisites, fees and the next available batch.

Do you provide placement support?+

We support career readiness through training, resume preparation, interview assistance and placement activities. Employment depends on employer requirements, candidate performance and available opportunities.

Can companies discuss a custom requirement?+

Yes. We work with businesses on technology development, recruitment, staffing and workforce training. Share your requirement through the contact page.

Can colleges collaborate with ZIVWA?+

We welcome discussions about skill development, student readiness, training and industry–academia collaboration. Contact us to explore a suitable program.
